verification_report.summary: All deductions in the submitted section check out. The proof treats positive closed currents at order zero, uses current Stokes only against smooth forms, and converts vanishing of the alpha∧beta trace into distributional base descent through positivity and fiberwise derivative vanishing. The Bott–Chern argument proves only pullback injectivity and the two-dimensional pseudoeffective/nef cone, correctly obtaining the 8pi trace coefficient and the de Rham-exact but Bott–Chern-nontrivial class. For semipositive non-big pullbacks, the potential, ordinary-envelope, all-weight ideal-envelope, and selected-section arguments respect fibers that are identically minus infinity and zero selected spaces. The top-degree extended measure is shown zero from bounded truncations and local two-dimensional Bedford–Taylor products. No lower-mass or bounded-mass estimate is used.
